Error.description: Failure envelope `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, details?, traceId? } }`. HTTP status mirrors `API_ERROR_HTTP_STATUS`.

NotConfigured.description: Fail-closed configuration error (apps/api/src/index.ts): `provider_unavailable` with "API is not configured yet", `Retry-After: 300`. Also used for provider outages and timeouts.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token. The Worker verifies it (JWKS or SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET) and forwards it to Supabase so RLS applies.

info.description: Generated by scripts/src/generate-openapi.ts from the ROUTES table and Zod schemas of @langquest/contracts. Do not edit by hand; regenerate (docs/api/README.md). Every JSON response uses the envelope `{ ok: true, data }` / `{ ok: false, error }` (CONVENTIONS §3). Error codes: unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, validation_failed, rate_limited, conflict, provider_unavailable, capability_unsupported, rights_blocked, idempotent_replay, payload_too_large, unsupported_media_type, precondition_failed, turn_in_progress, internal. Rate limits are operator abuse guards, never learner quotas (CONVENTIONS §6).
info.title: LangQuest API

get.description: Service banner: `{ ok: true, data: { service: "langquest-api", env, routes: <registered route count> } }`. Not in ROUTES (registered in apps/api/src/app.ts).
